text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are flat today, with both majors holding their overnight levels despite modest weakness in altcoins like BNB. The Fear & Greed index remains in fear territory at 34, though it has ticked up slightly over the week, suggesting some tentative stabilization. Bitcoin's dominance sits at 56.1% on $29B daily volume—a moderate level that indicates neither a risk-off flight to BTC nor aggressive alt-season rotation, pointing to consolidation and cautious positioning.
